A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same GCS study. Their main text, equations, figures, table, and complete appendices are readable and matchable despite additions and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original concept-vector similarity, classification accuracy, and plausibility experiments on three LLMs, plus emotion-steering results on Llama-2-7B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds Gaussian-mean PCA results in Appendix K.

M1.justification: The probing, diagonal Gaussian estimation, vector sampling, and intervention procedure remain unchanged. Section 4.4 newly specifies averaging sampled vectors for steering; this clarifies the existing experiment without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 16 concepts across sports events, populated places, animals, and movies, plus joyful/angry movie-review steering. Revised animal-generation prompts retain this coverage.

E2.justification: The Mean Difference and One Linear steering comparators remain unchanged; Mean Shift in the earlier examples is merely relabeled. Appendix K newly compares fitted Gaussian means against sampled-vector averages for PCA, adding a limited representation comparator.

E3.justification: Animal-positive prompts change from requesting 50 generic paragraphs in v1 Appendix I.4 to 100 detailed, 30–50-word descriptions requiring the category name in v2 Appendix J.4. This revises the reported generation protocol, but does not establish dataset regeneration or experimental reruns.

E4.justification: New Appendix K compares PCA using fitted Gaussian means with the sampled-vector averages used in Figure 5, testing sensitivity to the concept summary vector across three models. Existing layerwise analyses and sampling-distance sweeps remain.

E5.justification: Repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, and significance reporting practices do not change. The retained 1,000 observed vectors and 1,000 sampled vectors describe GCS construction and evaluation, rather than newly added uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Figure 10 adds the finding that Gaussian-mean PCA nearly matches sampled-vector-average PCA. Figure 5's Gemma projection is updated while retaining its clustering interpretation. Table 1's numerical scores, existing faithfulness results, and generated-review examples remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 8 is rewritten as separate observed-vector and sampled-vector accuracy expressions with the same respective test sets. This is equivalent reformulation; the Gaussian assumptions and other mathematical content remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: Gaussian concept subspaces, faithful and plausible representations, and effective emotion steering while preserving fluency. The additions do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: New Appendix A acknowledges dependence on GPT-4o-generated data, hierarchy-only plausibility assessment, and potentially inaccurate GPT-4o judgments. Appendix K additionally interprets Gaussian means as suitable concept representatives.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code repository link, explicitly documents sampling with replacement and averaging sampled steering vectors, and identifies displayed examples as randomly selected. Animal-generation instructions are substantially more specific; hardware and existing hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5 adds hierarchy-related work citing Nickel and Kiela, Chen et al., He et al., and Park et al. (2024), plus a Jin et al. citation for probing. It trims K-means/PCA and attention-head discussion and removes the Adaptive Activation Steering reference without substantially reframing the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 makes local prose and terminology corrections, shortens introductory explanations, updates publication and corresponding-author information, and adds limitations and Gaussian-mean PCA appendices. Existing appendices are renumbered, while the main narrative structure remains stable.

P2.justification: v2 adds the three-panel Figure 10, revises Figure 5's Gemma panel and aligns its title with the layer-26 subcaption, and resizes Table 1 while moving explanatory notes into its caption. Other figures retain their displays.

improvement.justification: v2 improves transparency through clearer sampling and steering details, a reported code link, and explicit limitations concerning synthetic data and automated judging. The Gaussian-mean PCA comparison and hierarchy-related references add useful context. These are limited gains: the central evidence remains largely unchanged, and revised generation prompts are not linked to documented reruns.
